page_title: NAP 3-2 PIS | Napoli v Pisa 22/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Valerio Crezzini has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+2' Alberto Gilardino has decided to substitute M'Bala Nzola and he is replaced by Matteo Tramoni (Pisa).
90+1' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' 3 - 2 Lorran (Pisa) scores a goal! He picks up a sweet pass and coolly slots the ball into the top right corner.
85' Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
82' 3 - 1 Goal! Lorenzo Lucca (Napoli) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the top right corner. He makes it 3:1.
82' Valerio Crezzini shows the yellow card to Mateus Lusuardi (Pisa) for a heavy challenge.
81' Here comes a substitution. Juan Jesus (Napoli) is brought on as a substitute for Alessandro Buongiorno.
80' Alberto Gilardino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lorran (Pisa) replacing Marius Marin.
77' The referee signals a substitution. Lorenzo Lucca (Napoli) is brought on as a substitute for Rasmus Hojlund.
74' Today's match ends for Giovanni Bonfanti who will be replaced by Samuele Angori (Pisa).
73' 2 - 1 Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) picks up a brilliant lofted pass just outside the box and smashes the ball into the bottom left corner, giving the goalkeeper no chance.
72' Matteo Politano (Napoli) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
69' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Valerio Crezzini didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
67' Matteo Politano (Napoli) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
66' Alberto Gilardino is stunned as referee Valerio Crezzini shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
61' Alberto Gilardino has decided to make a change. Henrik Meister (Pisa) replaces Stefano Moreo.
61' Substitution. Juan Cuadrado (Pisa) replaces Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris.
60' 1 - 1 Goal! M'Bala Nzola (Pisa) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Alex Meret to commit before slotting the penalty into the middle of the goal.
59' M'Bala Nzola (Pisa) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
59' Handball! A player from Napoli handled the ball. Pisa are awarded a penalty! What an opportunity to score.
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Frank Anguissa (Napoli) replaces Eljif Elmas.
57' Here is a change. Billy Gilmour is going off and Antonio Conte gives the last tactical orders to Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli).

57' Ebenezer Akinsanmiro (Pisa) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the crossbar, but Alex Meret easily deals with the threat. Pisa will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

54' A precise low pass is received by Scott McTominay (Napoli), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Pisa.
53' Matteo Politano (Napoli) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box.
50' Antonio Caracciolo (Pisa) receives a yellow card for infringement.
46' The whistle blows and Valerio Crezzini starts the second half.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
45+1' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa).

45+1' The ball is crossed into the box and Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the right side of the goal, but Alex Meret gets a glove on it to thwart him. Pisa win a corner.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
44' Billy Gilmour (Napoli) sends a cross into the box, but Adrian Semper comes off his line to gather the ball.
39' 1 - 0 Billy Gilmour (Napoli) picks it up in space and from the edge of the box lashes in a shot that is deflected past the helpless Adrian Semper. 1:0.
30' Marius Marin (Pisa) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
27' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Eljif Elmas (Napoli) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
23' Adrian Semper comes off his line to intercept the corner from Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli).
23' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
22' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) will take a corner kick.
18' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
11' NO PENALTY after a VAR review! The Pisa players are visibly unhappy with the call.

11' Play continues despite the shouts by some Pisa players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Valerio Crezzini interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
8' An attempted cross from Simone Canestrelli (Pisa) is cleared.
5' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Valerio Crezzini blows his whistle for an infringement.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Pisa will kick the game off.
Valerio Crezzini is introduced as the referee for today's match.
